Our Story

A Taste of Guadalajara, Jalisco

The torta ahogada is the pride of Guadalajara — a sandwich born in Jalisco that is "drowned" (ahogada) in sauce and eaten with your hands, just like back home.

At Tortas Ahogadas Guadalajara, we bring that tradition to Fort Worth. We are a well-known Fort Worth spot for tortas ahogadas, made with crusty birote-style rolls, slow-cooked carnitas and the bold chile sauce the dish is famous for.

Come hungry — and don't be afraid to get a little messy. That's how a real ahogada is enjoyed.
